This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''[[Corporal/Legends|corporal]]''' served aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. He had the nerve to interrupt a conference on the bridge between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and three [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] concerning the political situation in the [[Iskalon system/Legends|Iskalon system]] to notify Vader that circumstances there required his immediate attention.
